reuse.why: Five actions take the flag through the existing getFillableCategories helper; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own pre-existing filter and gets the flag there instead of a shared predicate.

duplication.why: The new 'unless includeHiddenCategories' rule is written twice, once as a conditional SQL fragment in getFillableCategories and once as a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: All edits are in budget/actions.ts where the month-wide action rules already live.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing and a release note; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Simple and readable, with a single default-false parameter, though a future change to the hidden rule still has to be made in two forms.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth already used its own budget-data filter before the change; the diff extends that existing path rather than introducing a new bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden/group-hidden exclusion gated by includeHiddenCategories appears as an interpolated SQL WHERE fragment in getFillableCategories and as a boolean expression in copyPreviousMonth (budget/actions.ts).
